# STAROT

> Free web observatory: tarot, an astrology star map, numerology and the Maya count, drawn in stardust, plus a generator that turns your readings into tattoo flash designs.

STAROT is a single-page web app by Porto visual artist Miguel Ferraz Guedes. It runs in any browser, with no account or install, in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

- **Tarot:** three cards (past, present, future) dealt from the 22 major arcana.
- **Astrology star map:** the sky at your birth date, time and place, with planets, houses and the rising sign.
- **Numerology:** the numbers in your name and birth date, such as the life path.
- **Maya reading:** your day sign, tone and cross in the 260-day sacred count.
- **Tattoo flash generator:** turns your readings into nine original designs on two print-ready flash sheets, downloadable as a sheet, single SVG/PNG files or a ZIP.

All readings are free. The tattoo flash files are free until 15 January 2027. Readings are computed in the browser; birth details are not sent to any server. Readings can be shared as links: the Share button creates a share URL that replays the reading when opened.

## FAQ

- Can I get a free tarot reading online here? Yes. STAROT deals three cards from the 22 major arcana (past, present and future) and reads them for you, free, with no sign-up.
- What is a birth star map? Your astral map: the sky as it stood when and where you were born, with the planets, the houses and your rising sign.
- What is a tattoo flash generator? STAROT turns your readings into nine original designs on two flash sheets.
- Is it free? Yes. All readings are free, and the tattoo flash files are free until 15 January 2027.
- Is my birth data stored? No. Your name and birth details are processed in your browser; the readings send nothing to any server.
- Do I need an account or an app? No. STAROT runs in any web browser, on phone or computer, with no account and no download.
